title: Agent-loop test: 'fifty cards are ONE job' queue time flakes over 1600 ms on CI
description: Master CI red on tests/agent-loop.test.cjs 'fifty cards are ONE job ... queued fast': 1697-1871 ms on GitHub runners (limit 1600) in runs 40099293204 and 40021715674, ~1020 ms locally and on passing CI runs. Find what stalls the batch queue path and fix it. Blocks MPI-1274's close.
